spec_match.rationale: The two counters are modelled at exactly the spec's definition points (bytes taken off the network vs bytes the app pulled), the invariant bytesRead ≤ bytesReceived is asserted, and the real getStats surface is probed before the model is shown.

interactive.rationale: Producer/consumer rate sliders, start/stop, three live meters and a debounced diagnosis all drive a genuine ReadableStream with a real reader loop.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a probe of the real surface plus a clearly-labelled producer/consumer rig; the page is exactly that, with the model badge rendered on the rig.

edge_cases.rationale: Equal-rate (gap stays 0), slow-consumer (gap grows), and drain (gap shrinks) regimes all produce distinct diagnoses; the Firefox rejects-NotSupportedError gotcha is carried in the code sample.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus and the spec section; the stats dictionary fields are quoted from the IDL.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pins the stats dictionary contract via the manual live assertion and the surface assertions this page's probe mirrors; 1 pass / 6 fail / 2 blocked honest on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): start/stop driven at both classes (equal rates: 152/152/0 KB) and a slow-consumer run (consumer 10 KB/s: received 176 KB, read 88 KB, gap 88 KB) with the backlog diagnosis rendered; overflowX 0 both classes, zero failed requests, clean console. Partial: the real getStats() call needs a live session on a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the surface probe ran and the model invariant (read ≤ received) at stop; intervals are cleared on stop and the reader lock released.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; meter bars use accent-blue/emerald/rose on ivory track with black border; the model badge is black-on-ivory inverse; buttons set both colors.

accessibility.rationale: Range inputs have visible labels with live value text and aria-describedby hints; the diagnosis is one polite live region updated at 1Hz (debounced, not spam); meters are labelled with visible text values, not color-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×900 with 0px horizontal overflow; sliders are full-width with 44px hit areas; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Call the real getStats() against a live session
openQuestions.detail: When an HTTP/3 WebTransport endpoint is available to a 158+ build, add a run that reads getStats() off a genuine incoming stream and renders the real counters beside the model's, confirming bytesRead ≤ bytesReceived on live traffic.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Debounce frequently-changing live regions; one polite region per surface; don't announce interstitial noise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Meters update visually at 10Hz but the aria-live diagnosis updates at 1Hz with meaningful regime text only; the probe panel has its own single static-rendered output.

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls range slider labels touch targets keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible labels tied to controls, value text that updates, adequate touch target size.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both sliders sit under visible labels showing the live KB/s value, have min-height 44px, and aria-describedby explains what each rate drives; keyboard arrows work natively.

summary: Slow-consumer diagnosis rig on a genuine ReadableStream behind a real surface probe and an explicit local-model label. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: equal-rate and backlog regimes both exercised for real (gap 0 KB and 88 KB), invariant held, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
